comment: Fe(II)- and O₂-dependent nonhaem iron enzyme; homologue of ergothioneine sulfoxide synthase EgtB. Catalyses oxidative C–Se bond formation between hercynine and SeGlcNAc via a selenoxide intermediate that spontaneously eliminates to yield selenoneine and 2-acetamidoglucal.

reactions.description: Oxidative C–Se bond formation between hercynine and SeGlcNAc, yielding a selenoxide intermediate (GlcNAc-SEN=O) that spontaneously undergoes selenoxide elimination to produce selenoneine and 2-acetamidoglucal (2AG).
